description: The signed-in member's Studio: the images and videos they have made, newest first, each with its id and a private link that works for one hour; anything still being made; and whether they have set up their own AI avatar and voice (their clone). Use it to find the id of an image before turning it into a video, and to see whether a video has finished. If a video they started has finished, this is also what saves it and takes the payment they agreed to when they started it; the result says so. If one is still being made, say so and look again in a minute rather than repeatedly.
